description: Monitor Google Maps reviews and detect only NEW ones, with Bayesian urgency classification and optional Slack alerts — your reputation radar. Use when tracking review activity for local businesses. Returns review objects flagged isNew with urgency scores. Pricing: $0.25 per run + $0.01 per new review.

alertThreshold.description: New reviews with this rating or lower trigger a Slack alert
alertThreshold.title: Alert threshold (stars)

dryRun.description: Testing mode: skips Slack alerts, state writes, and billing events
dryRun.title: Dry run

maxPlaces.description: How many businesses to monitor (from placeUrls or the search query)
maxPlaces.title: Max places

maxReviewsPerPlace.description: How many recent reviews to scrape per business
maxReviewsPerPlace.title: Max reviews per place

placeUrls.description: Google Maps place URLs (/maps/place/...) to monitor
placeUrls.title: Place URLs

proxyConfiguration.description: A residential proxy is strongly recommended — Google Maps blocks datacenter IPs.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

query.description: Google Maps search, e.g. 'restaurants Esch-sur-Alzette' — takes the first maxPlaces results. Ignored if placeUrls is non-empty.
query.title: Search query (alternative)

slackConnector.description: MCP connector to your Slack workspace. Authorize once in Apify Console → Settings → Integrations. The Actor only sees a connector ID. Leave empty to skip alerts (dataset only).
slackConnector.title: Slack connector (optional)

name: review_radar
